observations: Black PlayStation 4 Slim console with the PS logo visible on the front.
Two black DualShock 4 controllers are placed on top of the console.
A blue USB-C to USB-A cable is visible in the bottom right corner.
The console is sitting on a glass surface in what appears to be a retail or storage environment.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'JAY GLOBAL NIGERIA' is visible across the center.

risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully connecting to the PSN store.

risks.risk: The optical disc drive may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing a disc being inserted, recognized, and a game launching.
risks.if_unproven: as having a broken disc drive

risks.risk: The internal storage capacity may be less than 500GB.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the 'System Storage' settings menu.

risks.risk: The console may have overheating issues or a faulty power supply.
risks.proof: A video of the console running for at least 10 minutes without overheating.
risks.if_unproven: as having a faulty power supply

proof_requests: Video of the console booting to the home screen and connecting to the PSN store.
Video of a game disc being inserted and the game launching.
Screenshot of the 'System Storage' settings showing the actual storage capacity.
Photo of the back of the console showing the model number.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
